extracted.name: Purple Hooter
extracted.description: This purple hooter shot is a simple, delicious, and gorgeous cocktail shooter made with vodka, triple sec, and black raspberry liqueur served chilled.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups ice cubes, or as needed
instruction_lines: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice cubes; add vodka, triple sec, and raspberry liqueur. Cover and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted. Strain into a chilled martini glass.
